caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of grey graphite on a light-colored paper and depicts a large, ornate teapot viewed from the side, prominently centered within a larger rectangular frame. The teapot features a high domed lid with a finial on top, a wide rounded body, a long, slender, sharply curved spout, and a stout handle that is shaded dark. Decorative elements are visible around the top rim of the teapot and on the lid in the form of scalloped or leafy edging. On the body of the teapot, there is an engraved design consisting of a crest or shield with a butterfly or moth-like figure at the top, surrounded on each side by an olive or laurel branch. To the upper right of the main teapot image, there are two smaller, mirrored decorative motifs resembling sprigs or stylized leaves. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, less detailed outline drawing of a similar teapot enclosed in a square, labeled with the text “Master Drawing.” In the lower right, adjacent to the main teapot, there is a more detailed rendering of the crest or shield and laurel motif seen on the teapot’s body. The entire drawing is composed within a larger rectangle on the paper.
title: Silver Teapot
